answer: One defence is Airbnb host review history with platform attestation: a host profile with years of guest reviews the platform verified, and the beacon of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. A farm's usual trick is reuse, and this kills reuse outright: a host profile with years of guest reviews the platform verified is fresh per account, and the grove is that yesterday's proof is worthless today. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the yarrow of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
